Docs-Source Consistency Audit — faultdeck · 2026-11-02 (G3 batch) ​

  • Scope: README.md / README.zh.md / docs/** / todo.md
  • Method: ~/workspaces/standards/文档与源码一致性审计规范.md (three buckets + six steps); every claim evidenced at file:line; negative conclusions verified the search path first
  • Fix direction: source-wins — docs move toward the tree, never the reverse

Key state of the repo ​

Updated 2026-11-03 (supersedes the original 2026-11-02 "no implementation" snapshot below the line): the repository now carries a working implementation — a six-crate Cargo workspace: crates/core (shared FaultSpec/Target/Injection model + validate_injection + management-network overlap check), crates/netem (tc qdisc/filter adapter with preflight, rollback, dry_run executor), crates/agent (resident daemon, token auth, Mode A/B transport, iptables firewall), crates/cli (faultdeck remote ping/inject/rollback), crates/report (Scenario, RunReport JSON/HTML, SHA-256 hash, compare_runs history diff), and crates/coordinator (multi-target hub: registry/heartbeat/report archive). crates/protocol is an empty placeholder, not a workspace member. The MVP plan's toxiproxy adapter and scenario YAML DSL remain unimplemented; todo.md milestones FD-P1-4, FD-ARCH-1, FD-REPORT-1, FD-ARCH-2 are checked.

Verified, no action ​

  • README "Repository Layout (target)" is explicitly labeled as target — honest.
  • Status badge "in development / 开发中" describes the overall project (docs/design active); roadmap rows now carry per-phase truth.
  • mvp-plan acceptance gate "100% of faults rolled back" is a hard acceptance spec, not an achievement claim; todo.md "SSH/管理 IP 永不被注入" is a safety invariant — both legal per the copy standard.
  • AI-flavor sweep: no actionable hits (no bragging, no hollow-summary, no tutorial stance; emoji feature icons are vitepress theme config, not markdown decoration).
  • todo.md: 4 uniform unchecked requirement lines with acceptance criteria and prerequisites — already in ledger form, no changes.
  • README badges: license/Rust/backend/platform/status all point at real targets (docs/design/mvp-plan.md, LICENSE); zh badges point at the zh plan page.

Round 2026-11-05 — full re-audit after the implementation landed ​

Method: ~/workspaces/standards/文档与源码一致性审计规范.md (three buckets, six steps). Doc surface re-enumerated: README.md, README.zh.md, docs/** (en+zh), design/mvp-plan, review archive, plus the public face (gh repo view cuihairu/faultdeck). Every claim re-evidenced at file:line against the current tree; negative conclusions verified the search path first (e.g. grep -rn watchdog|lease crates/ = 0 hits across the actual crate tree).

Verified, no action ​

  • GitHub About line: "latency/loss/disconnect/partition scenarios as reproducible automated tests" — all four map to implemented faults (a CIDR partition is the iptables disconnect); homepageUrl points at the real site.
  • docs/design/mvp-plan.md marks unimplemented scope honestly (FD-P0-4 etc. unchecked); reports.md / remote-agents.md protocol sections re-verified against crates/report/src/lib.rs:79-88 and the WireMessage envelope (crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs) — accurate, including "queued; live dispatch not wired yet" (crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:173).
  • configuration.md constants re-verified: MAX_INJECTION_BYTES 64 KiB, PILOT_QDISC_HANDLE 100:, netem handle 50:, MAX_LATENCY_MS 24h (crates/core/src/lib.rs:104), chain FAULTDECK in mangle (crates/agent/src/firewall.rs:9-10).
  • AI-flavor sweep per ~/workspaces/standards/文档写作风格规范.md: banned vocabulary (标志着/赋能/打造/领先/自研/从零/综上所述/排比三连/seamless/robust/ leverage…) grep = 0 hits across README + docs; the fixes above removed the remaining over-claims and template-y emphasis lines. Vitepress feature icons remain theme config, not markdown decoration (carried over from the 2026-11-02 verdict).
